ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "The Communications Industry: Places, Practices and the Pillsbury Doughboy". This course will cover a variety of topics designed to help students learn more about the communication industry with an emphasis on the organizations, people and practices that make things happen in advertising, public relations, journalism and media. Registration restricted to students in the Exploration, LEADS, and Business LLCs. Please contact the Weston Explorer Program department for approval.
